title: Get available attribution sources and data sources for an app
content_data:
Use this endpoint to retrieve the attribution sources and data sources available for your mobile app when you create Upgraded Smart+ Ad Groups. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tool/available/attribution_source/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1738373164380162). | ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |advertiser_id {Required}|string|Advertiser ID.| |app_id {Required}|string|App ID.

To retrieve the App ID of a mobile app, use [/app/list/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-the-app-list/v1.3).| |optimization_event|string|Optimization event (Conversion event).

To learn about the enum values, see List of values for `optimization_event`.| |campaign_type|string|Campaign type.

Enum values:
  • `REGULAR_CAMPAIGN`: a campaign with the iOS 14 Dedicated Campaign setting disabled.
  • `IOS14_CAMPAIGN`: a campaign with the iOS 14 Dedicated Campaign setting enabled.

Default value: `REGULAR_CAMPAIGN`.| ``` ### List of values for `optimization_event` ```xtable |Optimization event{40%}|optimization_event value{60%}| |---|---| |Install|`ACTIVE`| |Registration|`ACTIVE_REGISTER`| |Purchase

/Purchase value (for Value-Based Optimization)|`ACTIVE_PAY`| |Checkout|`IN_APP_ORDER`| |Add to Cart|`IN_APP_CART`| |Generate Lead|`SALES_LEAD`| |View Content|`IN_APP_DETAIL_UV`| |Achieve Level|`UPDATE_LEVEL`| |Create Role|`CREATE_GAMEROLE`| |Loan is disbursed|`LOAN_COMPLETION`| |Loan Approval|`LOAN_CREDIT`| |Login|`LOGIN`| |Loan Apply|`LOAN_APPLY`| |Add Payment Info|`ADD_PAYMENT_INFO`| |Add to Wishlist|`ADD_TO_WISHLIST`| |Launch App|`LAUNCH_APP`| |Complete Tutorial|`COMPLETE_TUTORIAL`| |In-App Ad Click|`IN_APP_AD_CLICK`| |In-App Ad Impression|`IN_APP_AD_IMPR`| |Join Group|`JOIN_GROUP`| |Rate|`RATE`| |Search|`SEARCH`| |Start Trial|`START_TRIAL`| |Subscribe|`SUBSCRIBE`| |Unlock Achievement|`UNLOCK_ACHIEVEMENT`| |Ad revenue value (for Value-Based Optimization)|`AD_REVENUE_VALUE`/`IMPRESSION_LEVEL_AD_REVENUE`| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tool/available/attribution_source/?advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}&app_id={{app_id}}&campaign_type=REGULAR_CAMPAIGN' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |-|-|-| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/return-codes-appendix/v1.3).| |message |string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/return-codes-appendix/v1.3).| |request_id|string| The log ID of the request, which uniquely identifies a request.| |data|object|Returned data.| #|connected_data_source|string[]|The list of data sources that the app is connected to.

Enum values:
  • `MMP`: MMP (mobile measurement partner).
  • `EVENT_SDK`: TikTok App Events SDK.
  • `EVENT_API`: TikTok Events API.
| #|available_attribution_source_list|object[]|The details of the attribution sources and data sources you can configure for the app when creating Upgraded Smart+ Ad Groups.

You can pass the values from `available_attribution_source` and `available_data_source` to the `app_attribution_source` and `app_data_source` parameters when you call [/smart_plus/adgroup/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-an-upgraded-smart-ad-group/v1.3).| ##|available_attribution_source|string|The attribution source that you can configure for the app when creating Upgraded Smart+ Ad Groups.

The attribution source you choose will be used for optimization, bidding, and reporting.

Enum values:
  • `MMP`: MMP (mobile measurement partner) attribution. Signals from your selected MMP will be used for attribution.
  • `SAN`: SAN (self-attribution network) attribution. Signals from TikTok SAN will be used for attribution.
| ##|available_data_source|string[]|The list of data sources that you can configure for the app when creating Upgraded Smart+ Ad Groups.

The attribution signals you select will be used for reporting.

Enum values:
  • `MMP`: MMP signals. Signals from your MMP will be used for reporting.
  • `EVENT_SDK`: App Events SDK signals. Signals from TikTok App Events SDK will be used for reporting.
  • `EVENT_API`: Events API signals. Signals from TikTok Events API will be used for reporting.
| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "available_attribution_source_list": [ { "available_attribution_source": "SAN", "available_data_source": [ "EVENT_SDK" ] } ], "connected_data_source": [ "EVENT_SDK" ] } } (/code) ```
seo_title: Get available TikTok attribution and data sources for an app
seo_description: Use this endpoint to retrieve the attribution sources and data sources available for your mobile app when you create Upgraded Smart+ Ad Groups.
